name: TR-Obsidian Intelligence Network Citations — Bridge Launcher
description: Spawns the canonical vault MCP bridge (served only on its private Unix socket, vault-bridge.sock) tied to Obsidian's lifecycle; owns the fd-3 IPC channel for console capture and the bridge's vault operations (its only backend since 2026-11-25, in place of the Local REST API). Plugin ID is intentionally FROZEN — Copilot MCP tool ids, other plugins' api lookups and the bridge-token path all key on it; only the display name is suite-branded.
author: Trevor Robey
